notes.title: AMA: Ask Me Anything about Paper Cut
notes.content: [p]I’m hosting a live AMA (Ask Me Anything) session right here on Steam. This is your chance to ask me anything about [b]Paper Cut[/b], from the story, gameplay mechanics, and design choices, to the challenges of making an indie horror game.[/p][p]Whether you have played the game or are just curious, feel free to join in and start a conversation. I’ll be here to answer your questions, share behind-the-scenes details, and maybe drop a few hints about future updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45664726/d42806f7469700f1f05e523d8d4244c2132f9d8d.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Bring your questions, ideas, or even just say hi. See you there![/b][/p]
